info.name: HealthCare+ Backend API — Complete (71 endpoints)
info.description:
Full Postman collection for the HealthCare+ backend. Covers Auth, Patient, Doctor, MR, Admin, Pharmacy & Lab, AI & Emergency, Payments, and Real-time.

Setup:
1. Set `baseUrl` collection variable to `http://localhost:5001`
2. Run `POST Patient Login` or `POST Patient Register` — tokens are auto-captured
3. All protected endpoints use the `authToken` variable automatically
